Backend intermittently 503s (transient, retried by client). Confirmed live 2026-06-20.

steps.name: get-diagnosis-result-detail
steps._note: REQUIRED query params: diagnosis_id + diagnosis_request_sequence. With fake diagnosis_id: 404 ConfigDiagnosisIdNotFoundError. Needs real id from creatediagnosisobject (mutation-gated). Step exercises the endpoint with correct param signature.

lifecycles._note: COVERAGE-ONLY lifecycle for the 3 uncovered configinspection WRITE ops: POST /v1/configinspection/diagnosis/save (create a diagnosis object), POST /v1/configinspection/diagnosis/request (run a diagnosis), DELETE /v1/configinspection/diagnosis/terminate/{diagnosis_id} (terminate). Config Inspection diagnoses a CLOUD ACCOUNT (csp_type SCP or a foreign CSP) and the request/save bodies need REAL credentials of the account being inspected (diagnosisrequest: access_key/secret_key/tenant_id; diagnosisobjectrequest: a nested auth_key_request with a real auth_key_id, plus diagnosis_account_id). We do NOT have a throwaway inspectable account + auth key, so every write is a GUARDED OPTIONAL call with doc-sample ids and broad expect_status: it CALLS the endpoint (recording coverage for the 3 catalog keys) and 4xx's as expected. Bodies/field rules from data/api_docs.json (diagnosisobjectrequestv1dot3, diagnosisrequestv1dot3, diagnosisschedulerequestv1dot3, authkeyrequest) — v1.3 wave 2026-07-15: save gained REQUIRED check_list_version_id (fed by the new getchecklistversion GET, first step), request lost diagnosis_check_type, schedule_request slimmed to {diagnosis_start_time_pattern, frequency_type, frequency_value}. Body shapes LIVE-CONFIRMED 2026-07-15 (pass validation; still 404 at the credential lookup as designed). save returns FLAT $.diagnosis_id (configinspectioncreateresponse) — soft-captured so that, if save unexpectedly succeeds, probe-reads can exercise GET .../diagnosis/detail/{diagnosis_id} and the terminate DELETE targets the real id; otherwise terminate fires against the doc-sample {diagnosis_id} (still records the DELETE write, 4xx). diagnosis_name pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$. Each write is isolated in its own group so a 4xx is a warning, not a run failure; nothing real is created so teardown is the terminate call itself (no separate cleanup resource). CONFIRMED PARAMS 2026-06-20: getdiagnosisresultdetail requires diagnosis_id + diagnosis_request_sequence (both REQUIRED, validated via live probing). getdiagnosisobjectdetail path-param id format: DIA-<32hex-uppercase>.

steps.name: get-checklist-version
steps._note: getchecklistversion (NEW v1.3, same wave as the save-body change) — feeds save's new REQUIRED check_list_version_id. CONFIRMED LIVE 2026-07-15 (200): SCP's own checklist rows carry csp_type 'NURI' (csp_type=SCP filter returns 0 rows), so the filter selects the NURI/BP Active/Latest row (SCP_BP_* name). Soft-capture: if it finds nothing the save body keeps the literal placeholder and 4xx's (tolerated, optional step).

steps.name: save
steps._note: v1.3 body (DiagnosisObjectRequestV1Dot3, spec refresh 2026-07-15): NEW REQUIRED check_list_version_id (from get-checklist-version lookup step; omitting it gets 400 ValidationError 'Field required' — CONFIRMED LIVE 2026-07-15). diagnosis_check_type is STILL required in the save model (only the /request model dropped it). schedule_request is now DiagnosisScheduleRequestV1Dot3: diagnosis_id/use_diagnosis_check_type_bp/use_diagnosis_check_type_ssi REMOVED, diagnosis_start_time_pattern + frequency_value now required. CONFIRMED LIVE 2026-07-15: this exact body shape passes field validation — 404 ConfigAccessKeyNotFoundError (doc-sample auth_key_id, credential-gated as before), no longer a schema 400.

steps.name: request
steps._note: v1.3 body (DiagnosisRequestV1Dot3, spec refresh 2026-07-15): diagnosis_check_type REMOVED from the model (no replacement). CONFIRMED LIVE 2026-07-15: new 4-field body passes validation — 404 ConfigDiagnosisIdNotFoundError (doc-sample diagnosis_id, as before); sending the legacy field is silently ignored (same 404) but we follow the spec and drop it.

steps.name: get-diagnosis-detail
steps._note: id-bound read (show diagnosis detail). Closes the diagnosis_id getid GET /v1/configinspection/diagnosis/detail/{diagnosis_id}. Keys off the save-captured diagnosis_id ($.diagnosis_id, flat); tolerant [200,400,403,404] because save needs a real inspectable-account auth_key and 4xx's in a LIGHT run, leaving the id a doc-sample placeholder (normalizes to catalog '*'). Makes the endpoint statically reachable in a LIGHT run (complements probe-reads).

steps.name: get-diagnosis-result-detail-post-save
steps._note: REQUIRED params: diagnosis_id + diagnosis_request_sequence. Uses captured diagnosis_id from save step (falls back to doc-sample DIA-... placeholder). Will 404 unless save 2xx'd with a real account. Exercises getdiagnosisresultdetail with correct param shape.
